title: Solvation of copper(II), zinc(II) and lead(II) in monoethanolamine solutions attained via leaching of microwave-assisted-roasted sulfidic tailings
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21765-21780
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00733C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nor Kamariah, Sai Manoj Gali, Koen Binnemans, Jeroen Spooren
Microwave-assisted roasting of sulfidic tailings was followed by leaching of Cu, Zn, and Pb in monoethanolamine (MEA)-based solutions. The observed metal salt dissolution behavior in MEA–water systems was corroborated by DFT calculations.
